svg.title: Bundling the data versus fetching it
svg.desc: Fetching the dataset from object storage keeps the deployment package small and lets the data change without redeploying, but every cold start pays a network round trip and the function needs credentials and network access. Bundling the dataset into the deployment package makes the package much larger and means a data change requires a redeploy, but the data is present the moment the function starts and there is no network dependency at all. Under a hard memory ceiling with a short timeout, removing the network from the critical path was worth the size.
svg.text: − every cold start pays a network round trip
− needs credentials and network access to work at all
+ the data is there the instant the function starts
+ no network in the critical path, nothing to be denied
Under a hard memory ceiling and a short timeout, with data that
changes a few times a season, removing the network won.
